Method of Attack: Botnet operation using data centers and BGP hijacking to proxy traffic and generate fake ad requests
Impacted Systems: Data centers in US and Europe
Attack Vector: Proxying traffic through compromised IP addresses
Indicators of Compromise: More than one million compromised IP addresses in North America and Europe
Fake ad bid requests between 3 and 12 billion daily at peak
Fake ad traffic volumes dropped to near zero after takedown
